item.satisfying_weapons.desc.unlock_crit: To unlock, combine with an identical weapon of any level using Upgrader
item.satisfying_weapons.firework_sword.s: Hitting a mob grants 1_stack of {16711680}F{16755200}e{16776960}s{65280}t{39423}i{255}v{16711935}i{16711680}t{16755200}y{16777215}, up to 5_stacks. While in the air, press jump to consume 3_Festivity and do a Firework Jump. During a Firework Jump, sneak to do a plunge attack.
Plunge attack damage increases by_25% and is further increased by_15% for each mob in its current radius. Max damage increase is_100%.
For each mob damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_stack of Festivity. Max 2_stacks per plunge attack.
For each mob damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_HP.
Festivity can now go up to 10_stacks. Also, Festivity recovered from Level_3 is no longer limited to 2_stacks per plunge.
item.satisfying_weapons.toy_bow.skill_de: Shoots Toy Arrows that apply Birthday Party to the target. While the Birthday Party is active, the affected mob will cause all non-friendly entities to attack it.
Greatly increases accuracy and range of Toy Arrows. Also, there is a 50%_chance to keep an arrow while shooting.
When Birthday Party is applied, Birthday Gift appears above the target’s head. After the Birthday Party ends, or the target dies, Birthday Gift will fall down and explode.
Entities with Birthday Party are slowed down and receive 15%_more damage.
Hitting a Birthday Gift with a Toy Arrow will cause it to explode and fire 5_identical Toy Arrows in random directions, prioritizing other mobs as targets.
advancement.satisfying_weapons.root.desc: Kill monsters, craft wishes, collect weapons
